g.text: Fig. 1 My public repos on Keplerian orbits around a Schwarzschild black hole of 4.3 × 106 solar masses (Sgr A*), seen at 81°.
Periapsis advances 6πGM / c²a(1 - e²) per orbit (1PN), the disk turns at its local Kepler rate, the approaching side is Doppler-boosted. Time × 1200.
